name: Azariah
description: Daniel's compatriot living at the time of Exile and Return

points: Among those taken were of the children of Judah: Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

note.label: Daniel 1: The Best of Israel Carried to Babylon

points: The prince of the eunuchs gave them new names, Belteshazzar, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, part of assimilating them into the king's service.

note.label: Daniel 1: The Best of Israel Carried to Babylon

points: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions. His partners. That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret. We need to figure out what is going on. So he told his boys, let us ask God to reveal this to us.

There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego; these men, O king, have not regarded thee: they serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up. You see that? They did not give a damn.

note.label: Unity: The Sweet Savor Of Salvation

points: Whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace. Certain Chaldeans accused the Jews: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.

Certain Chaldeans came near and accused the Jews, telling the king that Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, whom he had set over the affairs of the province, did not regard him, serve his gods, nor worship the golden image.

note.label: Daniel 3: The Fiery Furnace and the Servants of the Most High

points: Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. Then they brought these men before the king. Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them, Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, do not ye serve my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up? So he came and questioned them. We know the story. We are running out of time. But the point is they faced death right in front of them and they did not waver. They did not waver.

note.label: Unity: The Sweet Savor Of Salvation

points: The furnace was so hot that the flame slew the men who carried Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego up to it.

note.label: Daniel 3: The Fiery Furnace and the Servants of the Most High

points: Nebuchadnezzar blessed the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who sent his angel to deliver the servants that trusted in him and would not serve nor worship any god except their own God.

note.label: Daniel 3: The Fiery Furnace and the Servants of the Most High

points: The fire had no power over their bodies, nor was an hair of their heads singed. Nebuchadnezzar then made a decree that no one speak anything amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort. But when you read the history, Nebuchadnezzar did not hold true to that at all; he went right back to his idolatrous ways. These are the things we have to read, learn, and implement in our own hearts, minds, and souls, because these events will occur again.
